error_message: Railway healthcheck failed: 1/1 replicas never became healthy (14 attempts over 5min, service unavailable)
root_cause: start script used `npx serve -s dist` — npx downloads the serve package at container startup, which exceeds Railway's healthcheck window
fix: Added `serve` as a real dependency in package.json and changed start script to `serve -s dist` so it's installed at build time and starts instantly

error_message: ⚙ Setup button not visible / 'There is no setup'
root_cause: setup-btn and remove-btn had `opacity: 0` with `:hover` reveal — invisible at rest, poor discoverability. User also seeing cached PWA build
fix: Removed opacity:0 hover-gating so buttons are always visible. PWA uses registerType autoUpdate; full tab close/reopen activates new SW

error_message: Code tab hangs on perpetual skeleton loader with bad/expired GitHub token, no error shown
root_cause: useRepoBrowser.loadTree had no try/catch — a failed getTree call left the tree empty and loading state stuck with no surfaced error
fix: Added treeError state + try/catch in loadTree; CodeExplorer shows the error message and a Retry button (onRetry=loadTree)

error_message: Tasks and Output tabs render completely blank (no content, no empty state) before project-log.json exists
root_cause: empty-state blocks were gated behind `log && ...` so when log was null (no token / no file) nothing rendered at all
fix: TasksTab returns a dedicated empty state when !log; both tabs show empty copy based on task counts rather than log presence

error_message: Setup button success/failure visually indistinguishable; no feedback on failure
root_cause: toast auto-dismissed after 3s, easy to miss; handleSetup already had error toast but timing too short
fix: Extended toast duration from 3s to 5s in useToast.js

error_message: Hub Autopilot runs every 2h but does nothing; all GitHub features in the app return 401
root_cause: GitHub token ghp_148... is expired/revoked (401). It is hardcoded in 4 places in the autopilot trigger prompt (brain curl x2, backlog curl, git remote), so every autopilot run fails at Step 0/1 silently. Token also stored in plaintext in the trigger config.
fix: PENDING — user must generate a new ghp_ (repo scope), then RemoteTrigger update trig_01Hyk3nY4NjgEadfHt43APXM to swap the token in all 4 spots, then paste into Hub sidebar. Long-term: stop hardcoding the token in the prompt (use api_token_hint / secret injection).

error_message: GitHub API 404 on repos/itaipeter/ListoPosto and repos/itaipeter/Project-hub — all tabs fail for those projects
root_cause: Project entries in Hub sidebar saved with misspelled owner "itaipeter" (user email is itaipeter@gmail.com but GitHub account is "itaypeter" with a y). GitHub user itaipeter does not exist.
fix: Remove the misspelled projects in the sidebar and re-add as itaypeter/<repo>. Token itself was valid — 404 was owner typo, not auth.

error_message: Code tab: files unclickable (selection instantly wiped); app hammered GitHub API in infinite loop — 68,350 requests in ~40s; status bar stuck on loading
root_cause: Render loop: storage object in App.jsx rebuilt every render -> destabilized useProjectLog.loadLog; App loadTree/loadLog useCallbacks depended on whole hook objects (repoBrowser/projectLog) which are new each render -> tab useEffect depending on them re-fired every render -> fetch -> setState -> render -> repeat. Each loadTree resets selectedPath, so file clicks appeared dead.
fix: App.jsx: wrap storage in useMemo; destructure stable inner callbacks (projectLog.loadLog, repoBrowser.loadTree, brain.loadWiki) and use them as useCallback/useEffect deps instead of the hook objects. Verified: 68,350 requests -> 7.

error_message: Setup button: failed: GitHub 404: (user browser) — but PUT CLAUDE.md returns 200 with the correct classic token
root_cause: GitHub returns 404 (not 403) on writes when the token lacks write permission. User likely saved the read-only fine-grained github_pat_11... token in the sidebar instead of the classic ghp_ token. Reads (tree) work, writes 404.
fix: Re-save the correct ghp_ classic token (repo scope) via sidebar change button. Code needs no change.
